annexedModal.title: Territory Annexed
annexedModal.description: The last defense fortress of {country} has completely fallen and been occupied by {attacker} military aggression. Your national sovereignty has officially ended and all territory has been annexed.
annexedModal.finePrint: Territory annexation ends your leadership. Restarting will restore the country initial status from default data.

peringkat.title: YOU HAVE BEEN OVERTHROWN
peringkat.subtitle: Presidential Rating Collapsed
peringkat.desc: Public and parliamentary trust in you has reached zero. Parliament held an emergency session and unanimously impeached you from the Presidency. Citizens took to the streets celebrating the fall of your government. Your presidency has officially ended.

kepuasan.title: PEOPLE REVOLUTION
kepuasan.subtitle: Public Satisfaction Reached Zero
kepuasan.desc: The people no longer trust your government. Mass protests turned into a national revolution. The military sided with the people and you were forced to resign. A transitional government will be formed to restore national trust.

kesejahteraan.title: TOTAL HUMANITARIAN CRISIS
kesejahteraan.subtitle: Public Welfare Index Zero
kesejahteraan.desc: The quality of life has fallen to an intolerable level. The UN imposed international sanctions. Starving and homeless citizens forced you to step down. Your country has been declared in a humanitarian emergency by international bodies.

satisfaction.title: Public Satisfaction Crisis
satisfaction.label: Current Public Satisfaction:
satisfaction.desc: Public satisfaction with your government performance has plummeted! Citizens are protesting your cabinet policies across regions. Immediately take social action and launch cultural festivals to boost national morale before instability grows!

welfare.title: Public Welfare Crisis
welfare.label: Welfare Index:
welfare.desc: The quality of life and human development in your country are in the crisis zone! Basic education, healthcare, public places, food, and housing facilities are severely lacking. Build sectoral infrastructure and distribute social aid programs immediately to save public welfare!

rank.title: National Security Warning
rank.label: Your Rating:
rank.desc: Public trust in your leadership has reached a critical level! If your rating drops below this number, you risk impeachment by parliament. Immediately raise your rating by fulfilling public aspirations and organizing aid programs!
